messages.text: Hi! I just wanted to chat for a bit. I'm based in Delhi, been living here for a few years now.
Nice to meet you! Delhi's a great city. What do you do there?
I work at Infosys as a Software Engineer.
That's great, how do you like it so far?
It's good! Also I have a dog named Rocky, he's a golden retriever.
Rocky sounds adorable!
Hey again. Just wanted to say, I tried this amazing biryani place near my office.
Oh nice, biryani is great! Is it your favorite food?
Yeah, biryani is definitely my favorite food.
Good to know! Any weekend plans?
Just relaxing this weekend, nothing major.
I'm starting to plan a trip! Thinking of going to Goa in August.
Goa in August sounds fun, though it's monsoon season there.
Yeah I know, but I really want to see the rain. That's my travel plan for now.
Sounds like a nice getaway.
Big news! I got a new job.
Congrats! Where are you working now?
I moved to Zomato. I'm now a Senior Software Engineer there.
That's a great step up! How's the new role treating you?
It's exciting so far, definitely busier than Infosys.
Random thing, I've actually changed my mind about my favorite food.
Oh really? What is it now?
Dosa. I've been eating it way more than biryani lately, it's my favorite now.
Dosa is a solid choice too!
Quick update on my travel plans.
Sure, what's changed?
I decided against Goa. I'm now planning to go to Manali in September instead.
Manali's beautiful, especially with the mountains. Good choice!
Another big update - I actually moved cities.
Oh wow, where to?
I moved to Pune, mainly because of the new job at Zomato.
That makes sense, closer to work maybe?
Exactly, cut my commute a lot.
Rocky's doing great by the way, just got back from a walk with him.
Glad to hear Rocky's doing well!
Yeah he loves the new neighborhood in Pune.
That's sweet.
I've been reading this really good sci-fi novel lately.
Oh nice, which one?
It's called Project Hail Mary. Really gripping so far.
I've heard great things about that one!
Yeah, definitely recommend it if you're into space stuff.
